name: Medal
summary: Round gold, silver or bronze medal hanging on a V-shaped ribbon; anim swing sways it. Use for sports wins and awards.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the ribbon knot

params.name: y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 about 420 px wide and 700 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: swing = the medal sways on its ribbon (pivots at the top)
